parsed.name: revision_flow_leaders
parsed.strategy: I bet on analyst revision flow, not target levels: every name has net target raises across at least three distinct firms over the trailing 90 days, and I deliberately excluded high-upside names where the flow is negative (ALB -12, FLUT -15, CEG -6, OKLO -4). The book is pharma/biotech plus software plus semis, each with a dated Q4 print or PDUFA inside the six-month window so the flow can be confirmed or broken by real events. I would be wrong if the revision flow mean-reverts: a single guidance cut or CRL at any of the 13 names flips its flow negative and the stock de-rates faster than SPY.
parsed.objective: Maximise 126-session return versus SPY, net of costs, by holding the strongest 90-day net analyst-target-raise flows across at least three distinct firms.

strategy.brief: Analyst revision flow: names with the strongest 90-day net target RAISES across >= 3 distinct firms. The flow, not the target level (target-level upside is measured perverse). Personal book: long only, 6-month horizon (126 sessions), no per-name cap, declare cash explicitly (0 is a declaration), graded net of costs against SPY.
